# JMP reader fixtures

These native `.jmp` fixtures come from the test suite of
[`JMPReader.jl`](https://github.com/jaakkor2/JMPReader.jl), version 0.2.2.
They are used to verify that StatData Converter reads native JMP tables without
JMP software.
